sinopsis.es: Zaffan, de 12 años, la primera de sus amigas en llegar a la pubertad, descubre un secreto aterrador sobre su cuerpo.
sinopsis.en: Twelve-year-old Zaffan's body undergoes a shocking transformation, forcing her to confront the fear of those closest to her. She meets the wild, free-spirited Farrah, who refuses to be controlled, and together they push against society's expectations.
